**Finding submitted — RENEWAL: deviation (fallback cure).**

- **Responsive clause:** § 4.1 (p0024) is the only renewal provision: automatic successive one-year renewals on each anniversary, exitable only on **ninety (90) days'** written notice by either Party.
- **Analysis:** Renewal term (12 months) is fine, and the 90-day window is not itself walk-away territory (which requires *longer* than 90 days), but it exceeds the fallback ceiling of a 60-day non-renewal notice window — a material fallback failure, so a redline is warranted.
- **Price uplift:** § 3.1 fixes consideration at 30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month with no renewal escalation mechanic anywhere in the document, so the price-increase element is not engaged (mapped already_met). The preferred-only 60-day Vendor reminder and CPI/3% cap are rationale notes, not deviations.
- **Edit:** single surgical replacement of "ninety (90) days written notice" with "sixty (60) days written notice" — no collateral text touched, and the "Termination Date" mechanic and Termination Payment cross-references remain intact.
